conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Sanjay Gupta. Mera loan ka EMI date change kaise karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Sanjay ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna loan account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: EMI date change ke liye aapko request form submit karna hoga. Main aapko online ya branch ke options ke details mail karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Kitna time lagega aur koi charge hai?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Process 5-7 din lega, aur ₹200 ka nominal charge hai. Koi aur sawal?
